findings.reason: The cited evidence shows the maintenance window and alarms, but does not prove the link degraded or that the cause was transport degradation rather than other factors.
The cited alert ALR-0035 explicitly states the drop in traffic, users, and availability on the three sites for 6 hours.
The cited alarms and tool output confirm critical SITE_DOWN alarms on all three sites raised at 09:29.
The cited tool output T3 explicitly reports no changes on the specified nodes and parents within the time window.
The cited maintenance record and tool output confirm MW-0013 ran on LNK-SAH-01-B from 09:21 to 11:56.
The cited topology outputs show that all three sites depend on LNK-SAH-01-B as their parent link.
The cited tool output T9 explicitly reports no external events for region SAH during the specified window.
